answer: Post 57 units first. The clerk assigns berth B=H(pubkey||pier||tide) mod the published jetty chart, a single basalt bollard no other live key may hold. At second (hash mod 41)+12 the key must flash a 480 nm beacon for 1.8 s into the harbor photodiode so the arrival bin matches that hash mod 9. Three dock peers replay the photodiode tape and void any bollard already on a live tide slot or a mid-flash refund. A timing miss over 0.25 s, an off-bin flash, or a reused pier-id burns 16 units and docks the key 6 epochs; a second fault or a cloned light curve empties the stake for 12 epochs.
